minutes.headline: Committee agreed to hold a priorities-only workshop Oct 6 after school office space shortfall surfaced.
minutes.summary: The committee heard the superintendent say school administration space and archival storage in the TC Passios plan were still inadequate, then debated how to prioritize town offices, schools, PAC and community uses. The design team reviewed parking and site layout, drainage, and conference room uses and stage question. Members agreed to a workshop on priorities and approved two sets of prior minutes.

decisions.decision: Hold a committee-only priorities workshop Tuesday October 6 at 5:30, with public comment at the end; keep Oct 14 and 22 meetings.
Architects will follow up with the town clerk on interim election space and send a recap and updated plan; committee to mark up plan for storage and school space.
Reorganize and elect a clerk on a coming agenda, along with the vacancy.

what_happened.line: The committee agreed to hold a committee-only workshop on priorities on Tuesday, October 6, with public comment at the end; the Oct 14 and Oct 22 meetings stay.
The superintendent said school administration space and archival storage in the current plan were still inadequate, and members debated how to rank town, school, PAC and community uses.
The design team reviewed parking, site layout and drainage; members questioned extra courtyard pavement, a conference room stage, and the added cost of vertical archive storage.
Architects will follow up with the town clerk on interim election space and send a recap and updated plan; the committee will mark up the plan for storage and school space.
The architect said the contract covers seven building committee meetings while nine are needed, so extra meetings may fall outside the contract.

why_it_matters: The plan for the town offices and school space is not settled, and how the committee ranks competing needs will shape the building's size and cost, which would be paid mostly through taxes.
Extra design meetings may fall outside the architect's contract, which could add to the project's design cost.
